most_relevant.description:
Great place to chill and work! I’ve been at Third Wave Coffee on Church Street, Bangalore, for a few days, and the team has been so friendly and welcoming.

Irfan and Thanila did a coffee-making demonstration right at my table, explaining the process, coffee weight, filtering, and timing. The coffee was great too, and Nisha was also very helpful.

Overall, a really nice experience. Would happily visit again.

Third Wave Coffee (Church Street) is a decent weekend pitstop if you don't mind a crowd. The matcha coffee is a standout hit, and their classic black coffee is equally well-brewed.
Service is just average, and the space gets incredibly noisy and packed on weekends—but that’s expected for the location. Great for a quick, quality caffeine fix!

Visited this café on a Saturday night in March 2026. It wasn’t crowded, but the ordering process was quite inconvenient. You’re expected to scan a QR code, which redirects you to the Play Store to download their app. After installing, you have to sign up/login before you can place an order. Personally, I don’t find this acceptable just to order food. The alternative is to walk to the cashier and place the order manually. Once the order is placed, the staff brings it to your table.

We ordered a Veg Bonanza pizza, a Mexico sandwich, and a banana cake. The pizza had very limited veggies — the “bonanza” name feels misleading. The pizza itself was quite hard, and the base seemed like it might be outsourced rather than freshly made. The crust edges were especially hard.

The sandwich tasted good, but it wasn’t warm or hot when served. The banana cake was the highlight — it was fresh, soft, and really tasty.

Lastly washroom was not at all clean.

Overall, the experience didn’t meet expectations, and I wouldn’t plan to visit again

The morning combos are exceptionally good. Especially the pancakes made by Krishna, she did an amazing job.
The coffee and ambiance makes you want to keep working

I came in for a coffee and a snack a left with a coffee tasting experience.

I was served pour over coffee by Sukumar, who explained and the entire life of the “medium light roast coffee beans” - where it came from, where it is currently being grown. He also displayed the method of making a cup of pour over coffee - the temperature of the hot water, the direction and speed at which the water should be poured, the blooming of the coffee, and finally the ready cup!

Loved this experience and the coffee.
Good ambience. An another good franchise of third wave coffee here in church street.

The have no WiFi.
They didn’t fill the water jugs even after asking 4-5 times.
We can’t even charge the phone.. plug points are not working.
Among all third wave stores this place is very bad . Waste of money.
-Bad service.
- washroom is not maintained.

This is one of the best places to work from! The atmosphere is relaxed yet vibrant, their chocolate milkshake is excellent and the staff is always welcoming. I had a great time working here it’s a perfect spot for productivity and good vibes.
